comment: Pinned to .NET 11. vigil-core ships self-contained (docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-016), so the
target host needs no runtime and the SDK alone decides what is built: pinning it keeps
builds reproducible on a machine with several SDKs installed.
rollForward latestFeature allows 11.0.x patch and feature updates, nothing above 11.
The test runner opt-in: xunit.v3 runs on Microsoft.Testing.Platform, and without this
`dotnet test` routes to the old VSTest host and refuses outright.
